spec.assertion: hitCount:60 trigger — recovery-event count tracks shots/60, not shots. Fails under the nearest-wrong shotFired/interval trigger (order-of-magnitude more activations).

heal effect to all allies (target set = every comp slot); asserted damage-inert via counterfactual (strip heal → totals byte-identical), so it can never smuggle damage. Tandem note: it is the live channel for any 'on recovery' teammate.

buffApply stat=partsDamagePct value=2, maxStacks=5, expiresFrame-frame=300, all allies. Fails under (a) generic attackDamagePct mis-encoding — caught by the strip-counterfactual requiring byte-identical totals, (b) unstacked/permanent duration.
it.skip — no EffectDef mutates another buff's maxStacks; target set alliesOfElement Water is expressible but the payload is not. Must be listed in unmodeled.skill1.
every burstGenPct apply frame ∈ fullBurstEnd frames and ∉ fullBurstStart frames. Fails under the fullBurstEnter mis-key (the classic trigger-identity error), which shifts every apply frame ~10s.
burstGenPct value=10, window 300 frames, all allies. Fails under a self-only target set or a permanent duration.

every maxAmmoPct apply frame ∈ fullBurstStart frames, and the apply-frame count equals the fullBurstStart count — so a burstCast mis-key (fires only on rotations SHE bursts, and pre-FB) fails on both frame identity and count.

value=40, window 900 frames, all allies; PLUS a value→0 counterfactual that must LOWER summed team damage — proving the line is modeled as a real shot-count lever (taxonomy 6), not skipped as defensive.
an instantReload (fraction 0.4) firing at FB-entry frames; asserted alongside reloadSpeedPct buff count === 0, so the nearest-wrong 'reload speed ▲40%' encoding fails.
reenterStage:1 — stripping it must not increase stage-1 burstCast count; the faithful model keeps stage 1 open for another Burst I. Fails under omission or under a burstEligibility mis-encoding.
heal to all allies on burstCast; strip-counterfactual proves damage-inertness. Kept (not skipped) because it is the recovery channel for on-heal teammates.
it.skip — two missing primitives: no healing-received stat (heal carries no HP amount) and no 'buff at max stacks' gate. Must be listed in unmodeled.burst.

fixtures: controlComp('alice-wonderland-bunny', true) with the fixed B3 slot ON — she is Burst I, so the control's B2/B3 are required for the chain to complete and for fullBurstStart/fullBurstEnd to exist at all (a lone unit makes ZERO Full Bursts, and both of her skill2 lines are FB-keyed). Deterministic, no seed. One base run captured via cfg.onEvent, hoisted at module scope; four counterfactual runs (strip partsDamagePct, zero maxAmmoPct, strip reenterStage, strip heal) — 5 full 180s sims total, well under the ~20-run budget. Non-vacuity is asserted explicitly: she must fire >180 shots (so the 60/90 thresholds are crossed repeatedly) and the comp must produce both fullBurstStart and fullBurstEnd events (so both FB triggers are exercised, active AND inactive phases present).
gaps: skill1 'Stack count of buffs ▲ 1' (Water Code allies, 90 normal attacks) — no EffectDef can raise another buff's maxStacks; the trigger (hitCount:90) and target (alliesOfElement Water) are both expressible, only the payload is missing. it.skip'd; belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

burst 'Incoming healing ▲150% for 15 sec' at max Carrot Party stacks — heal effects emit a recovery event with NO HP amount modeled, so a healing-received multiplier has nothing to scale; additionally no gate expresses 'when a named buff is at max stacks' (resourceGate reads resource pools, not buff stacks). it.skip'd; belongs verbatim in unmodeled.burst.

⚑ NOT a gap but a flag: 'Carrot Party' Damage to Interruption Parts is modeled as partsDamagePct and is INERT on the partless scope-lock boss. Kept in the model for completeness and asserted inert; any future parts modeling makes it live.
